qset.question: What is the weight of the Financial Services sector in the Nifty 50 index?
Which company has the highest weight in the Nifty 50 index, and what is its weight?
qset.answer: HDFC Bank Ltd. with a weight of 10.27%

qset.question: What was the Nifty 50 Total Return over the last 1 year?
If a company is one of the largest listed firms in India but is not eligible for Futures & Options (F&O) trading, can it become a constituent of the Nifty 50 index?
qset.answer: No. Only companies that are allowed to trade in the F&O segment are eligible to be constituents of the Nifty 50 index.

qset.question: Which sector has the greatest influence on movements of the Nifty 50 index, and why?
qset.answer: Financial Services has the highest sector weight (36.18%) and the index is calculated using a free-float market capitalization methodology, making heavily weighted sectors more influential on index performance.

qset.question: If market conditions change sharply in August 2026, would the constituent companies of the Nifty 50 necessarily change immediately?
qset.answer: No. While the index is calculated in real time, constituent changes occur through the semi-annual rebalancing process based on January 31 and July 31 cut-off dates.
